title: AWS Artifact: compliance reports and agreements

kcs.statement: AWS Artifact is a self-service portal where customers download AWS's compliance reports on demand, such as SOC, ISO and PCI attestations, to give to their auditors.
AWS Artifact Agreements let a customer review, accept and manage agreements with AWS, such as the Business Associate Addendum (BAA) needed for HIPAA, for one account or a whole organization.

problem_ideas: An external auditor asks for AWS's SOC 2 Type II report by Friday. Where do you get it?
A health-tech startup must sign a BAA with AWS before storing PHI. Which part of Artifact handles this?
Pick Artifact or Config: 'prove AWS's data centres are PCI certified' and 'prove our S3 buckets are encrypted'.
Does Artifact scan your resources for compliance? Explain.
A company with 40 accounts wants to accept the BAA once for all of them. Is that possible?
Name the keyword pattern in exam questions that points to Artifact.
